title: MidiClip
description: MIDI clip + note payloads: arguments/results of midi_add_clip, midi_set_notes, midi_get_clips (Rust mirror: src-tauri/src/midi/types.rs). ALL musical positions are integer ticks at the project PPQ (debt D-02: never seconds, never samples). On the IPC surface notes travel as JSON arrays on the clip; in project.json v2 they are persisted as AMEV binary chunks ($defs persistedClip). Emitter contract — no additionalProperties:false (D-06).

tick.description: Onset, ticks relative to clip start.

noteId.description: Stable per-clip note identity (round-2 §2.1). 0 = unassigned (wire sentinel); every note inside the document has id >= 1, minted from its clip's persisted watermark and never reused (ADR 0001). Additive (D-06).

clip.title: MidiClip (IPC)
clip.description: In-memory/IPC form: notes inline, sorted by (tick, key).

contentLengthTicks.description: Content (loop/native) length in ticks — ADR 0004's content half of the placement/content split; lengthTicks stays the placement length. Absent means "same as lengthTicks" (pre-looping semantics). When lengthTicks > contentLengthTicks the content repeats to fill the placement; when shorter, content is cropped. Additive (D-06).

persistedClip.title: MidiClip (project.json v2)
persistedClip.description: Persisted form: notes live in an AMEV chunk file (16-byte records; layout in src-tauri/src/midi/events.rs), referenced relative to the .aura dir.

contentLengthTicks.description: Content (loop/native) length in ticks — ADR 0004's content half of the placement/content split; lengthTicks stays the placement length. Absent means "same as lengthTicks" (pre-looping semantics). When lengthTicks > contentLengthTicks the content repeats to fill the placement; when shorter, content is cropped. Additive (D-06).

eventsRef.description: Relative path of the AMEV chunk, e.g. "events/<clipId>.bin". Chunks are immutable-once-written; edits write a new chunk under a new UUID (SCALABILITY §4).

patternId.description: RESERVED for the pattern/playlist milestone (SCALABILITY §3): when set, this clip is an instance of a shared pattern and eventsRef is absent.

nextNoteId.description: Persisted note-id watermark (round-2 §2.1, C-1): the durable authority for the clip's next-minted note id — written unconditionally (even for an emptied clip, which writes no eventsRef) so the watermark survives independently of the AMEV chunk. Loaded as max(row, chunk). Additive (D-06).
